name: mcp-jupyter-driver-sync
description: Auto-revert .ipynb notebooks when Claude (via mcp-jupyter-driver) writes them, so collaboration feels live.

commands.title: mcp-jupyter-driver: Revert active notebook from disk

mcpJupyterDriverSync.debounceMs.description: Debounce window for back-to-back external writes (e.g. run_cell streaming output flushes every 200 ms). Auto-revert fires this many milliseconds after the latest change.

mcpJupyterDriverSync.autoRevertWhenClean.description: Automatically revert externally-modified notebooks whose in-memory copy is not dirty. When the editor IS dirty, a status-bar item is shown instead.
